findings.reason: the plan must state the pipe counts as a change source inside `wait` (drain it and return true), else an implementer adding the pipe to the select while keeping the early False return silently defeats the one path the feature exists to deliver.
findings.text: §2 says "The stream's wait selects on that pipe beside its own inotify descriptor", but the cited owner `_ProjectChangeWatch.wait` (serve.py:196-205) returns `False` — which the stream loop `while watch.wait(self.connection)` (serve.py:2814) treats as a disconnect and exits — whenever `self.fd` is not in the readable set, unconditionally; a cross-node change fires only the subscription pipe (the whole reason every inotify watch is silenced in this test), so the inotify fd is silent, `wait` returns `False`, and the stream closes before it can emit the `change` the done-when requires

response_events.reason: s2 revised (8fe892030): _ProjectChangeWatch.wait drains a readable subscription pipe and returns True, as for its inotify descriptor, and returns False only on a client disconnect.
